feature: Owned physical presentation of supported dead native actors
milestone: M15 and Vilverin expedition remain open
behavior: Dead native actors with a rendered physical NIF can enter the existing owned scene/body path. Previously the death branch returned before that admission, leaving the Skeleton in its attack pose or a bind pose after reload.

The original Skeleton collapses using its authored17 bodies and13 joints. Physics, renderer and cached snapshot publish together; an existing snapshot restores its body identities and collision filters.
Dead actors retain physical ownership without entering GetUp. Existing recovery cleanup still retires its graph, then rebinds actor pointers after publication.
Cold corpses retain life/killer, Health, XP, inventory, native death counts and innate ownership. A fresh kill emits one death callback and creates one physical owner. Schema99 unchanged.
limits: This reuses the existing physical Down profile; exact original death motor timing, impulses and weapon-drop behavior are not certified.
Models without a physical definition retain their existing legacy death handling.
This course certifies Skeleton presentation and ownership, not all Creature models, NPC death courses, resurrection or general M15 completion.
The axe remains in the original corpse inventory; independent loose-weapon death drops and corpse loot are separate work.
